notes.title: Closed Alpha is Live!
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to the ALARA Prime Closed Alpha Playtest![/h2]

We are gradually accepting players to the Closed Alpha with the hope of granting everyone access. 

[h3]Sign up on Steam to get access.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629369/97ba60d7346dc06973b661eb3dd0fd2c3857f98f.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/971700/ALARA_Prime/

The application is called "ALARA Prime Playtest" on Steam. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629369/34225cb6f851948febd5f2a4bbc6fe66f2421f97.png[/img]

If you have played before, you will need to swap out the branch to [None]. Verify integrity of files or restart Steam and you will get access to the Closed Alpha.

[h3]When is Closed Alpha?[/h3]
January 23 (4 PM CET) - February 3 (4 PM CET) 

[h3]Where is Closed Alpha?[/h3]
Steam Windows PC

[h3]Join us on [url=discord.gg/alaraprime]Discord[/url]![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/971700/ALARA_Prime/

[h3]What regions are included in the Closed Alpha?[/h3]
We will gradually grant access to players from different regions. If you’re located in North America or Europe you are likely to get access. More regions will be included depending our servers and capacity.
[u]Server locations:[/u]
[list]
[*] US East
[*] US West
[*] Central Europe
[*] Korea
[*] Brazil
[/list]
[h3]Will there be an in-game reward for joining the Closed Alpha?[/h3]
Players that participate in the Closed Alpha will be rewarded an exclusive weapon skin. The skin will be granted when the game releases.

[h3]What are the system requirements for Closed Alpha?[/h3]
[u]Recommended:[/u]
[list]
[*] OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
[*] Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel Core i7-9700 CPU
[*] Memory: 16 GB RAM
[*] Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 / AMD Radeon RX 6800
[*] Network: Broadband Internet connection
[*] Storage: 30GB available space
[/list]
[u]Note:[/u] Please keep in mind that these specs are for the Closed Alpha specifically. We are still optimizing and the launch specs might be lower.

[h3]Can I record and stream the Closed Alpha?[/h3]
Yes! We love to see your clips, memes, bug reports and anything in between. 

[h3]Are there cosmetics?[/h3]
There will be skins in ALARA Prime but they have been disabled for the Closed Alpha.

[h3]Will any progress I make during the Closed Alpha carry over to the live game?[/h3]
No. XP will be disabled and any progression will be deleted when the game is launched.
